transcript: My friend, life feels different after 40, doesn't it? Not heavier in your body, heavier in your heart. The responsibilities grow, the noise gets louder, and suddenly the world asks more from you than it gives back. You wake up carrying thoughts, worries, decisions, people, all on your shoulders. And the joy you once felt so easily now hides behind long days and tired moments. You don't laugh the same, you don't rest the same, you don't dream the same. And it's not because you are failing, it's because you have been strong for far too long without anyone noticing. But hear me, you are allowed to put the weight down, you are allowed to return to yourself, you deserve peace again. If you want a gentle path to reconnect with your mind and your spirit, my 30-day healing journey is waiting for you. The link is on my profile.
